contract.goal: every module sits under build/, services/ or sources/ by role, so the three-POM split is visible in the tree and a module is findable by listing one directory
contract.output: 29 module directories moved; root POM, 29 module POMs, Jenkinsfile, manifest generator, gate script, Stop hook and all path-bearing prose updated; a repository-layout spec and a --check-layout check added
constraints: no artifact coordinate changes - same groupId, artifactId, version
no in-repo dependency edge changes; the regenerated manifest must show an identical graph
no behaviour change and no src/ change beyond path references in prose
every module parented by common gets an explicit relativePath ../../pom.xml
module selection moves to -pl :artifactId so a future move cannot break it

decisions: build/ + services/ + sources/ chosen over a flat sources/ for everything non-service: burying ludwig-bom and ludwig-service-parent among 21 starters hides the three-POM split, which CLAUDE.md calls the thing to get right. The user picked this layout from three options.
sources/ is NOT split into libs/ and starters/: it would make 'library or starter' a judgement call on every new module for one more level of nesting

the bare `build/` entry in .gitignore was removed before creating the directory - it is a NetBeans/Gradle pattern, vestigial in a Maven reactor where output goes to target/, and it would have silently ignored the entire new build/ tree
module selection switches from -pl <path> to -pl :<artifactId> rather than relearning paths, so the next layout change cannot break the gate or CI
the layout check lives in scripts/manifest.sh, not ArchUnit or Checkstyle: a directory's position is a filesystem fact that bytecode analysis and source-text analysis both cannot see
the Dockerfile's `-pl` and its jar path inside the builder stage were switched to :artifactId and services/ respectively; its 45 COPY paths were prefixed

the `db-core/web-core` phrase in idempotency's POM comment is prose meaning 'db-core or web-core', not a path, so the rewrite was scoped to module names followed by pom.xml/README/src/target rather than by any slash
failures: PRE-EXISTING, not caused by this change and not fixed by it: services/notification-service/Dockerfile copies 12 module POMs while the reactor declares 29, so `docker build` fails on 'a parent pom whose <modules> name a directory that is absent' - the failure its own comment predicts. At HEAD it was already 12 of 25; four modules added by earlier work (cache, messaging, test-support, test-support-security) widened the gap. Fixing it means deciding which modules the image's build actually needs, which is a separate change. jib is the supported image path and is unaffected.
